Implementation Plan I have what I need: the PR-body composer, the merge handler with its #7160 binding, the #7328 automated-restart block, the poller's merged-issue sweep, the activation-verify skip, and the three copies of the plan prompt. Here is the plan. --- Implementation Plan — Issue #7657: track the remaining scope of a deliberately partial delivery Scope-mode: Selective Expansion Reuse-audit: extends the `issue_pr_status.yml` #7160 binding (`resolve_unmerged_close_login`), the `clarify.yml` #7328 release block (`# BEGIN/END pr-dependency release classification (#7328)`), `scripts/auto_decisions.py` (PR-section rendering that breaks up `#`) and `close_merged_issues_sweep` / `_pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr` Scope-mode justification: The answers chose Q1:A, Q2:A, Q3:A and Q4:A. That means: keep the issue open on a partial delivery, cover every standalone pipeline issue, and use an explicit `## Deferred scope` block in the approved plan as the only signal. The never-clarified sweep is split out. Changing `Closes` to `Refs` alone does nothing, because `issue_pr_status.yml` links the issue through the `ai/issue-` head branch. The merge handler therefore has to honour a bound marker, and clarify has to treat the restart as automated. Two small additions make the guarantee complete: - A matching guard in the poller's `close_merged_issues_sweep`, which would otherwise close an issue still labelled `ai:ready-to-merge` if it ran before `issue_pr_status.yml`. - A bound deletion of the stale `ai/issue-` head branch, so the next implement run does not stack on squash-merged commits. Both are under 30 lines each and add no new interface. Per §6 (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > …), completeness wins. Orchestrator-managed children and tracking issues are excluded (AD-2). ### Automation / §20.E - New script: `scripts/partial_delivery.py` is a helper library/CLI that only existing automated steps call. Nothing runs it by hand, it is not a supervisor, and no `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry is needed. - Entry points it wires into (all existing triggers): - `.github/workflows/plan.yml` through `scripts/run_plan_codex.sh` (on `/answer`): prompt only. - `.github/workflows/implement.yml`, step "Pre-flight — lint PR title/body…" (on `/approved`): composes the PR body. - `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml`, step "Update linked issue labels when PR closes" (`pull_request: closed`): merge handling. - `.github/workflows/clarify.yml` route step (`issue_comment`): automated restart. - `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` `close_merged_issues_sweep`, through `orchestrate_poll.yml` (cron `*/5`): race guard. - No database work and no new supervisor. ## Files likely to change - `scripts/partial_delivery.py` - `.github/workflows/implement.yml` - `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` - `.github/workflows/clarify.yml` - `.github/workflows/internal-clarify.yml` - `workflow-templates/ai-clarify.yml` - `README.md` - `prompts/mode-plan.txt` - `prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt` - `scripts/run_plan_codex.sh` - `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` - `.github/workflows/ci.yml` - `docs/INVENTORY.md` - `tests/test_partial_delivery.py` - `tests/test_issue_pr_status_partial_delivery.py` - `tests/test_implement_pr_body_tracking_refs.py` - `tests/test_clarify_partial_delivery_restart.py` - `tests/test_partial_delivery_sweep_guard.py` - `tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py` - `changelog.d/7657-partial-delivery-tracking.md` - `agents.d/7657-partial-delivery-tracking.md` ## Functions or modules to implement 1. **`scripts/partial_delivery.py`** (new, stdlib only, run as `python3 -I -B`;
